Staff Software Engineer - Internal Tools

Remote - Americas

Step into the heart of Shopify's innovation as a Staff Software Engineer, building the internal tools that empower Shopifolk to create remarkable products for our merchants. Your work will shape Shopify's culture by designing powerful, intuitive systems that simplify complex tasks and enhance workflows. Join us to build and scale innovative platforms like Mastery, our learning and development tool, and Flex Comp, our flexible compensation system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable, reliable internal tools that solve real problems for Shopify teams.

  • Lead technical architecture decisions, balancing immediate needs with long-term vision.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to understand user needs deeply.

  • Mentor other engineers and elevate the technical quality of our internal systems.

  • Champion best practices in software development while maintaining pragmatism to ship effectively.

Qualifications

  • Deep experience in building and scaling web applications, with a focus on developer experience and internal tools.

  • Ability to turn complex workflows into intuitive, powerful interfaces.

  • Strong systems thinking and confidence in navigating technical decisions.

  • Clear communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails, React, or similar technologies.

  • Energized by understanding user needs and solving real problems.

  • Enjoy balancing speed with quality and managing technical debt.

At Shopify, we pride ourselves on moving quickly—not just in shipping, but in our hiring process as well. If you’re ready to apply, please be prepared to interview with us within the week. Our goal is to complete the entire interview loop within 30 days. You will be expected to complete a pair programming interview, using your own IDE.

This role may require on-call work.

Ready to build the tools that power Shopify from the inside out? Join us and make a significant impact across the company.
